_comment: ONE COLOURLESS, ONE DRAW LAND, A MANA ENGINE -- AND THE EMIEL IS IN THE LIBRARY.
USER, 2026-09-11: 'with one colourless on board, one draw land on board and a mana producing
engine you can always win the game.' And, writing rule 4 of the Combo Off table: 'the 1
colourless source works even when you have displacer out because you can draw into Emiel and
cast it if you can draw your deck.'
This is that board, built to make the sentence the ONLY thing under test:
* the outlet is Eldrazi Displacer, whose blink is {2}{C} -- one colourless PIP a pass;
* Mariposa Military Base is the board's ONLY {C} source, so c_refund 1 - c_cost 1 = net_c
ZERO. No number of iterations feeds Essence Depleter's {1}{C}: the drain is paid out of
the board's opening stock and nothing else. (Before Session 24 the apply ran ten blinks
and took the opponent from 10 to 9 -- one drain, exactly the opening Mariposa.)
* the lands otherwise make no colourless at all (Kitchen {G}/{U}, Conservatory x2 {G}/{W},
two Overgrowths), so total yield is 8 against a {2}{C} blink: net +5, an entirely healthy
MANA loop that simply cannot make pips;
* Peregrine Drake untaps five, i.e. the whole board, every pass;
* the draw land is live -- Mariposa's {5},{T} and two {4},{T} Investigates;
* EMIEL THE BLESSED IS AT LIBRARY INDEX 1, behind one Forest. Its blink is {3}: pip-free.
The board makes white off the two Conservatories, so {2}{W}{W} is payable.
THREE THINGS HAD TO MOVE TOGETHER and each has its own control, which is the point of the
fixture:
* CO_ENV='MTG_COMBO_OFF_MIDLOOP_OUTLET=0' -> still OFFERED at x27 and NOT VERIFIED. The
display believes the line; DeployPipFreeOutletFromHand used to iterate `hand` ONCE, before
iteration 0, so an Emiel the dig turns up at iteration five was never cast. That is the
executor gap Session 22 handed on, reproduced exactly.
* CO_ENV='MTG_COMBO_OFF_DIG_OUTLET=0' -> ABSENT. The sizer's swap credit was HAND-only and
its {C}-sink test was BOARD-only, so with Essence Depleter in play (which makes want_draw
false, so the loop never digs) and Emiel in the library, eff_net_c stayed 0 and no
multi-activation plan was built at all.
* CO_ENV='MTG_COMBO_OFF_OUTLET_SWITCH=0' -> ABSENT (the swap itself is the whole line).
Its negative control is edf_co_28 -- the identical board with no pip-free outlet anywhere,
which must stay ABSENT with every lever on.
